description: Validated, isolated re-measurement of research/inherited_f4_next_20261112 Run 2 at degree 13 [pcc:unverified]: the same factor base (binary-subspace:dimension=7) and target stream (walk) in front of the pair-table oracle (mitm:m=2, reference IC row) and of the m=2 symbolic descent solved by inherited-f4 and by fes-f2, with max_trials 2000000 as in the local sweep and no solver wall budget (deterministic, replayable).
